title: revisionTime
responsibility: Finds the authored timestamp of the selected commit or the current branch tip.

inputs.name: revisionTime.snapshot
inputs.description: Current project revision, branch tips and commit metadata; may be absent before loading.

inputs.name: revisionTime.kind
inputs.description: Chooses the selected commit timestamp or the timestamp of the branch tip.

inputs.name: displayTime.value
inputs.description: ISO timestamp to format; absent or invalid values produce the unknown-time label.

outputs.name: revisionTime
outputs.description: Authored timestamp for the requested revision, or null when metadata is unavailable.

outputs.name: displayTime
outputs.description: Localized date and time, or the explicit unknown fallback.
